scoring_justification: R² recomputed from agent's validation CSVs; overpotential compared with paper gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for N and B model R² thresholds, and 3-Para overpotential/onset potentials
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig.7d for N R²=0.93; Fig.S7 for B R²=0.96; Fig.8b and text for overpotential 0.48 V, onset -0.079 V, limiting step OOH formation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper reports; the reference solve.sh outputs will match, so full reward is reachable.

outputs.description: Fitted coefficients of the linear structural descriptor models (ΔG_OH vs. n_O, n_P, n_M) for N‑ and B‑doped graphene.
Validation set for the nitrogen structural model: per‑site structural counts, DFT‑computed ΔG_OH, and model‑predicted ΔG_OH. Used to recompute the goodness‑of‑fit R².
Validation set for the boron structural model: per‑site structural counts, DFT‑computed ΔG_OH, and model‑predicted ΔG_OH. Used to recompute the goodness‑of‑fit R².
ORR overpotential, onset potential, potential‑limiting step, and its free‑energy cost for the 3‑Para optimal site identified by the nitrogen structural model.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs rely on DFT total energies from process steps s1 and s2. The verification strategy is T0 (result‑level compare) coupled with metric recomputation: the checker will recompute R² from the validation CSVs and compare the overpotential/onset potential/limiting step against hidden gold values from the paper, with appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Check the fitted models file exists and contains required keys for N and B with float coefficients.
Recompute R² between DFT and model-generated ΔG_OH for nitrogen validation set; target is ≥0.93. Partial credit linearly between 0 and threshold.
Recompute R² between DFT and model-generated ΔG_OH for boron validation set. Target ≥0.96, partial credit linearly below.
Verify the overpotential, onset potential, limiting step, and step energy match the paper's reported values for the 3-Para site.
